text:
tara: Heads-up — planning to flip the capacity.pulse.burst flag for a limited canary during tomorrow's marketing spike test. Need on‑call coverage + guardrail checklist. Target: 09:00 PDT, 5% traffic, 30m. @dan @lucy @sanjay

lucy: OK — can scope to `audience=5%` and `region=us-west-2`. We'll enable queueing fallback and max_concurrency=200 for the canary group.

dan: +1. I'll watch SLOs and set an automated rollback if error-rate > 1.5% or p95 latency increases > 40%. What metric hooks do you want?

maria: Please add a tag `rollout:marketing-spike-2026-03-18` and enable verbose tracing for the canary only. Also ensure billing alerts are muted for this window so pages don't spam.

sanjay: Runtime note — when burst is enabled we'll pre-warm a small GPU pool. Add `warmup=2m` to avoid cold-start spikes. Also recommend KV-cache warm warming: `cache.prefill=true` for the canary.

ops-bot: @tara requested toggle preview:
```
rwctl toggle preview set capacity.pulse.burst --scope canary --audience 5% --region us-west-2 --params warmup=2m,cache.prefill=true,max_concurrency=200
```

lucy: Looks good. I'll prepare the rollout playbook in the incident doc and link it here before the window. Will also run a dry-run in staging at 06:30 PDT.

dan: For rollback, use this command if thresholds exceeded:
```
rwctl toggle set capacity.pulse.burst=false --scope canary --selector rollout=marketing-spike-2026-03-18
```

tara: Thanks. Quick checklist for tomorrow: 
- lucy: playbook link + staging dry-run (06:30)
- dan: SLO alarms + automatic rollback rules
- maria: tagging, tracing, billing mute
- sanjay: warmup + cache prefill confirmation
- ops-bot: scheduled toggle at 09:00 PDT with canary audience 5%

maria: I'll also add a small smoke eval set to detect hallucination regressions (10 queries). Want results within first 10m and then at 20m.

lucy: Playbook draft: https://redwood-internal/ops/playbooks/marketing-spike-2026-03-18 (will update).

dan: I'll be on standby 08:50–10:00 PDT. If anything odd, ping @dan and I'll take over.

tara: Perfect. If all goes well we'll ramp to 25% after a successful 30m canary. Otherwise we abort and investigate. I'll post a short post-mortem thread if we hit rollback. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Scheduled job created: toggle execute at 1738323600 (2026-03-18 09:00 PDT) — job id job-5821

tara: Thanks everyone — closing the loop here.
